subject: Phaseout: API v1.3 -> v2.0 migration ops & comms
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: dev_patel@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 02 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Phaseout: API v1.3 -> v2.0 migration ops & comms

Team —

As we discussed last week in product review, we're targeting a formal phaseout of API v1.3 and default model mappings to v2.0. Current proposal: deprecation announcement on 2027-06-15, enforcement (remove v1.3 runtime routing) on 2027-06-30. Before we lock those dates I need alignment on a few operational and comms asks: 

1) Engineering: list of endpoints that will see wire/response contract changes (schema, fields, streaming behavior). Any backward-compatible shims we can ship?

2) Runtime: can we support a 2-week canary (small percent of traffic) prior to enforcement? If so, proposed window: 2027-06-16 -> 2027-06-30. Also need a rollback playbook.

3) Customer success & sales: exemption process for enterprise customers who cannot migrate before enforcement (procurement/legal blockers). We need clear criteria and a decision SLA.

4) Dev docs & migration guide: canonical doc + migration script (examples for Node/Python) — who will own and ETA?

5) Comms: public blog, Console banner, in-product deprecation notice, and targeted emails for customers using v1.3 heavily. Draft cadence included in the linked drive.

Please reply with owners, blockers, and any reason we should move the dates. If any team needs more runway, call it out — this is still negotiable within reason.

Thanks,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: phaseout_comm_schedule_v1v2.pdf (timeline + comms cadence)
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 02 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Phaseout: API v1.3 -> v2.0 migration ops & comms

Grace —

Quick tech clarifications:

- Endpoint surface: the streaming /delta API signatures will change slightly (chunk framing and final status field). We can add a compatibility shim that maps old framing to the new stream, but it will add ~6–8ms p50 for affected requests. That impacts latency SLO for low-latency customers.

- KV cache: v2.0 changes to KV keys (prefix scheme) mean warmed caches won't be shared across versions. For customers relying on long conversations the cold-start token cost could be material. Suggest we document this explicitly and provide a small server-side adapter that rewrites cache keys for a 30-day bridge window.

- Canary: engineering can support a 10% traffic canary starting 2027-06-17, but we need the feature-flag infra in place (ownership: infra eng, ETA 2027-05-20).

Owners (tentative):
- Shims & cache adapter: Eng (SRE + Runtime) — Dev Patel
- Feature flag infra: Infra Eng — Raja (I'll loop him in)
- Rollback playbook: Runtime on-call + Eng Ops — Dev

If Product wants zero-latency regressions for top-tier customers, we'll need to push enforcement to mid-July. Otherwise the proposed dates are feasible.

Subject: Re: Phaseout: API v1.3 -> v2.0 migration ops & comms

Grace / team —

Thanks for the clear list. A few product-side notes and a suggested alternative schedule:

- Customer impact: internal estimates show ~18% of current active tenants call endpoints whose response shape changes. The Console usage dashboard will need an auto-surface for "customers using v1.3 in last 30 days" (owner: Console eng).

- Proposed enforcement moved to 2027-07-14 to allow:
  * 3-week canary window across multiple regions (June 16 - July 7)
  * Migration playbook and sample scripts to be authored and peer-reviewed (owner: Marissa Cole)

- Attached mapping: v1_to_v2_mapping.csv (includes endpoint table + recommended client-side changes).

- Comms: Product would prefer two-burst approach — public notice 2027-06-15, targeted account emails starting 2027-06-20. Also want a customer-facing compat FAQ.

Owners (product):
- Migration guide + FAQ: Marissa Cole (ETA draft 2027-06-01)
- Console banner & dashboard: Monica Patel (Console PM)

If engineering can commit to the cache adapter, I can support enforcement on July 14. Otherwise, we should keep the later date.

Cheers,
Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Product

Attachment stubs: v1_to_v2_mapping.csv
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 04 May 2027 13:56:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Phaseout: API v1.3 -> v2.0 migration ops & comms

Grace / Product —

Sales & customer success escalation: Acme AI (Sarah Wu) has opened a formal extension request — procurement + security review means they cannot commit to migration by 2027-06-30. They are asking for a 90-day extension (to 2027-09-28) and a short period of migration support credits. I've attached their extension request PDF.

My ask: can we define the exception criteria and a fast-path approval workflow? Practical suggestions:
- Automated eligibility check (customers with active Dedicated/DPA + >$X M ARR are auto-eligible for extension review).
- 2-business-day SLA for Product to make an exception decision once Sales files the request (we need to keep procurement timelines moving).

If we lock enforcement to 2027-07-14 (Markus' suggestion) it still doesn't cover Acme's needs. I propose we offer temporary routing for a limited number of enterprise tenants (handful) while encouraging migration with credits and a dedicated ENG migration slot.

Thanks everyone — good discussion. Summarizing decisions and next steps: 

Decisions:
- Target public announcement: 2027-06-15.
- Enforcement: 2027-07-14 (moved from 2027-06-30) to allow extended canary + docs.
- Canary window: 2027-06-16 -> 2027-07-07 (multi-region, ramp to ~10% traffic).
- Exceptions: Acme AI case accepted for review; we will offer temporary routing (limited enterprise exemption) pending legal/procurement sign-off.

Owners & deliverables:
- Migration guide + FAQ (draft): Marissa Cole — ETA 2027-06-01.
- Console banner & customer surfacing: Monica Patel — ETA 2027-05-20.
- Compatibility shim & cache adapter: Dev Patel (Eng) — ETA 2027-05-20 for feature-flag infra, 2027-06-01 for adapter prototype.
- Exception workflow: Karthik Iyer / Legal — define criteria + 2-business-day decision SLA by 2027-05-10.
- Rollback playbook & tracer hooks: Eng Ops (owner: Dev) — ready by 2027-06-10.

Action items (who does what):
- Marissa: create migration guide draft and upload to Drive (link above).
- Monica: add Console auto-surface for v1.3 usage and schedule banner copy review.
- Dev: loop in Raja for feature-flag infra and confirm canary ramp plan.
- Karthik: capture Acme's MAP and submit exception packet to Legal; attach link to HUBSPOT-12345.
- Grace: schedule a stakeholder sync for 2027-05-11 10:00 PT (calendar invite to follow).

If no objections, I'll circulate the comms calendar and public blog draft by 2027-05-06.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turn on this.

Grace
Grace O'Connor
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
